cases.label: production sub-path
cases.failLine: ORIGIN-FORM: https://color.babb.dev/gh-pages/ is not a bare production https://{color.babb.dev}/ origin — sub-path /gh-pages/ — a sub-path origin masks base-path defects

cases.label: production unlisted host
cases.failLine: ORIGIN-FORM: https://example.com/ is not a bare production https://{color.babb.dev}/ origin — host example.com (want one of color.babb.dev)

cases.label: production query
cases.failLine: ORIGIN-FORM: https://color.babb.dev/?q=1 is not a bare production https://{color.babb.dev}/ origin — query ?q=1

cases.label: production fragment
cases.failLine: ORIGIN-FORM: https://color.babb.dev/#x is not a bare production https://{color.babb.dev}/ origin — fragment #x

cases.label: production explicit port
cases.failLine: ORIGIN-FORM: https://color.babb.dev:8443/ is not a bare production https://{color.babb.dev}/ origin — explicit port 8443 (want none)

cases.label: loopback sub-path (G-13)
cases.failLine: ORIGIN-FORM: http://127.0.0.1:4173/gh-pages/ is not a bare 127.0.0.1:PORT origin — sub-path /gh-pages/ — a sub-path origin masks base-path defects

cases.label: loopback query
cases.failLine: ORIGIN-FORM: http://127.0.0.1:4173/?q=1 is not a bare 127.0.0.1:PORT origin — query ?q=1

cases.label: loopback fragment
cases.failLine: ORIGIN-FORM: http://127.0.0.1:4173/#x is not a bare 127.0.0.1:PORT origin — fragment #x

cases.label: loopback no port
cases.failLine: ORIGIN-FORM: http://127.0.0.1/ is not a bare 127.0.0.1:PORT origin — no explicit port
